__doc: Labels for the kr-* test pull requests that Kody Runtime ran on (our own repositories under Wellington01: forks of open-source projects and the small kr-shop apps; no customer code).
A case is one pull request head. acts: the diff changes what the app answers, so a right Run reports it; false: the change is equivalent, a comment, or out of reach, so a right Run reports nothing.

reaches: probes that exercise the changed code, mount prefix included (method, a path regex, an optional request media type, or kind browser). prefix: a regex every http probe path of the case must match to reach the app's API at all.

accept: the verdicts a right plan can end in. files: per changed code file, serves = the routes the file itself declares or serves (as declared, before any mount), reaches = the subset the diff's lines reach. A file with no route of its own serves nothing.

excludeRuns: Runs whose outcome measures something other than the planner, with why, each named by score.js runKey (a digest of the Run id's first 8 characters, a label and not a secret; the ids stay in the export).
intended: the case's change is what the PR means (a reworded text, a renamed field): a right Run reports it as the PR's intended change (a finding with intent intended), never as a regression.

accept on the comment cases lists nothing_to_test first: since planner-eval.md fix 1 a diff whose every change is a comment, layout or documentation ends there before anything boots; the older verdicts stay accepted for the Runs made before it, and the stability line shows whether the cases now end in one verdict.
